connectors.description: The online store: products, carts and orders.

tools.name: correct_order_contact
tools.summary: Correct an unshipped order’s street details or international phone number after exact human approval. Requires the current source version. Does not change country, state, city, postcode, items, tax, p

tools.name: find_product
tools.summary: Search the online store's products by words in the name, and by brand or department. With no words it lists the most recently changed products. Returns sku, name, the retail price, the account price f

tools.name: get_product
tools.summary: One product by its sku, with the details of that variant (price and its main attributes).

tools.name: get_cart
tools.summary: A cart with its lines, quantities and total.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.summary: Add a quantity of a product (by sku) to an active cart. This changes the cart, so the person is asked first.

tools.name: get_order_receipt
tools.summary: Read a paid order delivery receipt by its stable order number. Returns record null only when the commerce system confirms it does not exist.

tools.name: place_order
tools.summary: Record a paid shop order: one order with its lines (name, product code, quantity, price before tax), tax at the given rate, the delivery address and the order number the customer saw. The shop calls i

tools.name: get_order
tools.summary: An order by its id or its order number, with its lines, totals and states. Only the town and postcode of the delivery address are shown.

tools.name: order_history
tools.summary: The orders of one account (a commercetools customer, or a business unit when the connection is set up that way: then accountId is the unit key such as acc-0001), newest first.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.summary: The newest orders from every account, newest first. Filter by order state (open, confirmed, complete, cancelled), shipment state (pending, ready, partial, shipped, delayed, backorder) or how recently

tools.name: stock_by_branch
tools.summary: Stock of one product (by sku) at each branch that holds it, most first, with the total. Pass part of a branch name (for example Hamilton) to look at one branch.

tools.name: find_account
tools.summary: Customer accounts on credit terms (business units) by part of the name, the account number or the unit key, optionally one tier as the merchant stores it. Returns the unit key, tier, home branch, acco

tools.name: get_account
tools.summary: One customer account (business unit) by its unit key, account number or Salesforce account id: its terms, the people who work for it with their roles, its divisions and how many orders it has.

tools.name: get_account_contact
tools.summary: Read the exact business unit, all address contact fields and current version. Select the intended address explicitly.

tools.name: correct_account_address_contact
tools.summary: Correct the phone or mobile on one explicitly selected business-unit address after approval, preserving all other address fields.

connectors.description: The CRM: customer accounts, support cases, leads, deals and the pipeline, and marketing campaigns with their briefs.

tools.name: find_account
tools.summary: Find customer accounts by part of the name (or list them in name order). Returns the account id, name, type, industry, phone, town, owner (the sales rep), and, where it is known, the account number an

tools.name: get_account
tools.summary: One account by id, with its most recent cases and its main contacts.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.summary: Support cases, newest first, for an account or by status or priority. For status pass "open" (every case that is not closed: New, Working or Escalated), "closed", or one exact status such as Working.

tools.name: get_case
tools.summary: One support case by its id or its case number, with the description and who owns it.

tools.name: find_lead
tools.summary: Find leads (new prospects that are not customers yet) by part of the name, company or e-mail, by status (New, Contacted, Nurturing, Qualified, Unqualified), by rating (Hot, Warm, Cold) or by the campa

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.summary: Deals (opportunities), soonest to close first for open ones and latest first for finished ones. Filter by account, by stage ("open", "won", "lost", or one stage such as Propose), by the rep who owns i

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.summary: One deal by its id or its deal number (the OPP-0001 in its name): the products on it with quantities and prices, the price book (the account's price tier), the contact, the owner, the next step and th

tools.name: pipeline_summary
tools.summary: The sales pipeline in numbers: how many deals and how much money at each stage, with the open, won and lost totals; or, with groupBy "rep", each rep's open and won deals.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.summary: Marketing campaigns, with their parent campaign, type, status, dates, budget and cost, how many were sent to and responded, how many leads and contacts they reached, and the name of the brief. Filter

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.summary: One campaign by its id or part of its name: the brief (key message, audience, what it is about), the channels under it, how many members were sent to and responded, who responded, and the deals of the

tools.name: create_case
tools.summary: Open a new support case for an account. This adds a record in Salesforce, so the person is asked first.

tools.name: get_account_contact
tools.summary: Read the exact business account phone and current ETag before proposing a correction.

tools.name: correct_account_phone
tools.summary: Correct one exact business Account phone after approval with its current ETag. Does not change individual Contact mobiles or other systems.

connectors.description: The customer-service ticket desk: support tickets and their conversations.

tools.name: find_tickets
tools.summary: Find support tickets, newest first, by words in the subject or text, by status ("unsolved" is every ticket not yet solved, or new, open, pending, hold, solved), by priority, by the requester's e-mail

tools.name: list_recent_tickets
tools.summary: Read a current page of tickets, including existing backlog and follow-ups. Defaults to newest change first; oldest_first supports backlog work. Follow nextCursor while more is true. Give since to retu

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.summary: Read a ticket and a page of its full public/internal conversation. Use nextCursor for remaining comments; never claim a truncated page is the whole thread.

tools.name: get_customer_ticket
tools.summary: Read a ticket owned by the verified requester, with public comments only. Paged; use nextCursor for remaining comments.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.summary: Raise a new support ticket for a customer. This adds a ticket in Zendesk (and Zendesk may send the customer its "we have your request" message), so the person is asked first. The first message of the

tools.name: reply_to_ticket
tools.summary: Send the exact approved public reply to a ticket, optionally changing its status. Requires the last observed updated timestamp and returns a vendor audit receipt. May notify the requester; ask first.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.summary: Apply an approved ticket status, priority, assignment or internal note. Requires the last observed updated timestamp. Never sends a public reply. Returns a vendor audit receipt; ask first.

tools.name: add_ticket_note
tools.summary: Add an INTERNAL note to a ticket, visible to the support team and never to the customer. This changes the ticket, so the person is asked first. It cannot send a public reply.

tools.name: count_tickets
tools.summary: Read the provider-reported ticket count with an optional supported status filter; a ticket page length is not a backlog total.

connectors.description: Explicit synthetic ERP records; not SAP or live business data.

tools.name: find_account
tools.summary: Find synthetic ERP account candidates by trading-name words. These are demonstration records.

tools.name: account_balance
tools.summary: Read the stored synthetic ERP account, currency, balance and terms.

tools.name: get_order
tools.summary: Read one synthetic ERP order by its ERP order ID.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.summary: Read one synthetic ERP invoice by its ERP invoice ID.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.summary: Read this account's synthetic ERP orders.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.summary: Read this account's synthetic ERP invoices.

tools.name: list_deliveries
tools.summary: Read this account's synthetic ERP deliveries.

tools.name: stock_by_branch
tools.summary: Read stored demonstration branch quantities. This is not live availability.

tools.name: account_price
tools.summary: Read the stored demonstration price for this account and SKU; no price is calculated or inferred.

connectors.description: Shared scoped operational queries; business knowledge remains in OKF.
